text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:`cd .worktrees/req-029 && mkdir -p tmp && cat > tmp/req-029-analysis.md <<'EOF'
# REQ-029 — LAN collaboration opportunity discovery

Baseline: requirements-work at 0ae1a692. Historical scope: \`git show 6b28c838^:docs/development-roadmap.md\`, peer-tool opportunity research. Working scenario: a small team with Mesh Talk accounts can reach one another over an existing LAN while internet access is unavailable. They need to pass along files and know who can act on them.

## Evidence and hypotheses

- [LAN Messenger](https://github.com/lanmessenger/lanmessenger) documents LAN file transfer and announcements to selected recipients or everyone. This establishes precedent for quick recipient selection. It does not establish demand for network-wide sending in Mesh Talk.
- [BeeBEEP](https://www.beebeep.net/) describes local direct discovery, group administration and file transfers in its v6 beta. Treat the beta claims as first-party descriptions.
- [Bitchat](https://github.com/permissionlesstech/bitchat) documents BLE mesh without internet and internet-dependent geographic channels over Nostr. A site with no usable LAN is a different scenario requiring transport and platform validation.
- Mesh Talk already documents local discovery, group membership and recoverable file transfers. [Send files](../docs/help/topics/send-files.md), [Delivery](../docs/help/topics/delivery.md) and [Channels](../docs/help/topics/channels.md) distinguish file cards, available bytes and eligible sources.

## Candidate decisions

1. Improve a concrete handoff step if observation shows that people mistake a received card for an available file or cannot tell how to resume. First inspect existing status explanations and reuse the owning file transfer and delivery flows. A UI clarification is smaller in scope than introducing a new recipient receipt, which would need a privacy and protocol decision.
2. Consider a scoped announcement to known recipients if the current group flow is repeatedly too slow for people who frequently need to reach different sets of colleagues. Validate audience preview and confirmation. Network visibility alone gives no authority to contact an account.
3. Defer BLE evaluation until a verified use case requires communication with no reachable IP network. It introduces a new discovery/transport surface and native lifecycle evidence on each intended platform.

## Discriminating test

Use one sender, two intended recipients, and a visible account outside the group. Keep LAN connectivity, disconnect internet, and take one recipient offline during handoff. Observe elapsed time and user steps, whether recipients distinguish card arrival from usable bytes, whether recovery is understood, and whether the excluded account receives anything. Record any authorized source used on resume. If current behavior meets the need, close this scenario without adding a feature. Document review only so far. User demand, native runs, performance and cross-platform behavior remain unverified.
EOF
git status --short; git check-ignore tmp/req-029-analysis.md`}))

已从本地 `requirements-work` 的 `0ae1a692` 创建 `req-029` 分支，保留 [独立 worktree](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029) 供后续讨论。原工作区的未提交改动没有带入。此轮只做调研，未改产品代码，也未运行构建或测试。

**REQ-029 第一轮建议先验证「断互联网、局域网仍可达时，小团队能否顺利交付文件」。** 我从已退役的路线图找回了定义。这项需求是从具体场景出发寻找适合 Mesh Talk 的功能机会。

- **先看文件交付有没有理解断点。** Mesh Talk 已有局域网发现、群聊、文件传输和有条件的恢复。值得验证的是，接收方能否分清「文件卡片到了」「文件现在能下载」「文件已经可用」，以及遇到中断时是否知道怎么继续。 [文件发送指南](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029/docs/help/topics/send-files.md)
- **快速通知指定成员是第二个候选。** LAN Messenger 支持向指定收件人广播，BeeBEEP 6 的 beta 也展示了局域网发现、群组管理和文件传输。可以据此观察现有建群流程是否拖慢临时通知，以及发送前能否看清接收范围。目前还没有用户流程证据。 [LAN Messenger](https://github.com/lanmessenger/lanmessenger) · [BeeBEEP](https://www.beebeep.net/)
- **蓝牙对应另一个场景。** Bitchat 的 BLE mesh 可用于缺少可用 IP 网络时的通信。只有实际遇到这类场景，才有依据评估新传输层和各平台的后台行为。 [Bitchat](https://github.com/permissionlesstech/bitchat)

最能区分这些方向的是一次四账号走查：一位发送者、两位接收者、一位可见但不在群里的账号。断开互联网，让一位接收者在传输期间离线，记录交付步骤、文件状态是否好懂、恢复路径，以及群外账号是否收到内容。若现有流程已经满足需求，这个场景就可以在调研阶段收束。

[调研笔记](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029/tmp/req-029-analysis.md) 已写入 worktree 的忽略目录。同类工具的补充核查仍在进行中。 [REQ-029 peer tool evidence](t3-thread://v2/1846d2ec-4ca5-47c4-93e5-6df4204f2a77/thread:delegated-task:command%3Amcp%3Ae9b2340c-ffbe-4da9-8288-98a992d7123d%3Adelegate-task%3A4a5c16df-798d-475e-a3fe-37e598ac9452)

Why: “Based on” identifies the starting branch, and “before implementing anything” makes the phase explicit.

Completed the REQ-029 desk review and saved the [peer evidence](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029/tmp/req-029-peer-evidence.md). The comparison uses committed Mesh Talk HEAD `0ae1a692`.

**Mesh Talk already supports the core workflow** on a reachable LAN through invited channels, attachment approval and saving, and recovery from authorized peers or configured post offices. The strongest gaps to investigate are first-use setup, whether the sender can tell who actually saved the file, and what remains after the temporary group finishes.

- **LAN Messenger** documents serverless LAN chat, selected broadcasts, direct file transfer, and a group mode that sends a leave event when its window closes. Room-wide file delivery remains unverified. [Official repository](https://github.com/lanmessenger/lanmessenger) · [Chat-room source](https://github.com/lanmessenger/lanmessenger/blob/master/src/gui/chat/chatroomwindow.cpp#L460)
- **BeeBEEP 6 beta** provides the closest comparison for file handoff. It documents separate progress, acceptance, and resumable transfers for each group recipient. Recipients still need direct reachability to the sender for the bytes. [BeeBEEP site](https://www.beebeep.net/) · [File transfer guide](https://www.beebeep.net/docs/files)
- **Squiggle** historically documented portable startup and group chat. Current upstream sources confirm multicast discovery, peer-to-peer file transfer, and cross-subnet bridging. Current group-wide file delivery remains unverified. [Historical upstream README](https://github.com/hasankhan/Squiggle/blob/ef61dcc6169af47eb10e275e672d2114c43fdf7c/Readme.md) · [Current upstream README](https://github.com/hasankhan/Squiggle)
- **Bitchat** addresses the separate case where there is no usable LAN. Its Apple whitepaper documents public BLE mesh chat and accepted mesh files up to 1 MiB. Android documents optional password-protected topic channels. Private group file delivery across both clients remains unverified. [Apple whitepaper](https://github.com/permissionlesstech/bitchat/blob/main/WHITEPAPER.md) · [Android repository](https://github.com/permissionlesstech/bitchat-android)

User demand remains a hypothesis. The report includes concrete scenarios for testing it. No builds, runtime tests, code edits, or commits were made.

开源局域网聊天软件推荐
如果想找 不依赖云服务器、可在局域网内直接通信、开源 的聊天软件，下面几个比较值得关注：
项目	核心特点	适合场景
LAN Messenger ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐	无服务器、完全离线、AES-256/RSA-2048、文件传输、群聊；支持 Windows/macOS/Linux	最推荐，直接拿来用
LANChat ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐	Rust + Tauri，支持 Windows/Linux/Android/Web，聊天、文件传输、SQLite、本地发现	跨平台、适合二次开发
Mesh-Talk ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐	真正 P2P、端到端加密、Noise Protocol、无账号/云服务，支持离线网络	安全、隐私要求高
Squiggle ⭐⭐⭐⭐	P2P 局域网聊天、文件、语音、屏幕共享、聊天记录、跨子网	功能比较全面
BeeBEEP ⭐⭐⭐⭐	老牌 LAN Messenger，无服务器、群聊、文件传输、消息记录	传统办公室内网聊天
BLIP ⭐⭐⭐⭐	P2P 聊天、语音/视频、屏幕共享、大文件、群聊，无服务器无账号	功能丰富、喜欢新玩法
Technitium Mesh ⭐⭐⭐	P2P、DHT、强加密，可在 LAN/Internet/Tor 环境使用	隐私/P2P 爱好者
HostTalk ⭐⭐⭐	局域网自建服务，浏览器/PWA 使用	不想给每个人安装客户端
1. LAN Messenger —— 最推荐
真正的 Serverless LAN Messenger：
* Windows / macOS / Linux
* 不需要服务器、账号、互联网
* AES-256 + RSA-2048
* 文件传输
* 群组/联系人
* 消息历史
* 完全离线可用
目前官网提供 v1.3.9，适合直接部署使用。
项目： https://github.com/lanmessenger/lanmessenger
官网： https://lanmessenger.github.io/

2. LANChat —— 跨平台/开发者首选
技术栈比较现代：
Rust + Tauri + SQLite + WebSocket
支持：
* Windows
* Linux
* Android
* Web
* LAN 自动发现
* 文件传输
* 图片预览
* 消息记录
* 跨 VLAN / WireGuard 手动发现
如果以后想自己二次开发，这个项目很值得研究。
项目： https://github.com/cap153/LANChat

3. Mesh-Talk —— 安全性首选
核心理念是：
P2P + E2E 加密 + 无服务器
采用 Noise 加密通信、签名 LAN 发现、端到端加密消息，并支持离线消息转发。
支持：
* Windows
* macOS
* Linux
* 一对一聊天
* 群组
* 文件
* 完全离线 LAN
* 无云服务、无账号依赖
如果是实验室、企业内网、隔离网络等场景，我会重点考虑它。
项目： https://github.com/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk
官网： https://octopusgarage.github.io/mesh-talk/

4. Squiggle —— 功能最全面之一
除了普通聊天，还支持：
* 文件传输
* 语音聊天
* 屏幕共享
* 截图
* 聊天记录
* 消息翻译
* 跨子网通信
完全 P2P，没有中央服务器。
支持 Windows / Linux / macOS。
项目： https://github.com/hasankhan/Squiggle
目前 GitHub 有约 127 Stars、973 次提交，项目活跃度不错。

5. BeeBEEP —— 老牌经典
老牌的局域网即时通讯软件：
* 无服务器
* Windows / macOS / Linux
* 一对一聊天
* 群聊
* 文件/文件夹传输
* 消息记录
* AES 加密
优点是成熟、简单；缺点是整体技术和 UI 相对传统。
官网： https://www.beebeep.net/

6. BLIP —— 聊天 + 音视频 + 屏幕共享
比较“现代”的 P2P LAN Messenger：
* 文字聊天
* 群聊
* 语音
* 视频
* 屏幕共享
* 文件传输
* LAN Clipboard
* WebRTC
* 无服务器
* 无账号
* 支持 LAN / VPN
目前 2.0 仍在开发，适合尝鲜和关注后续发展。
项目： https://github.com/krwg/blip

最终怎么选？
想装完就用：
🥇 LAN Messenger
想 Windows + Linux + Android + Web：
🥈 LANChat
最看重安全和端到端加密：
🥇 Mesh-Talk
需要语音/屏幕共享：
🥇 Squiggle
喜欢老牌稳定方案：
BeeBEEP
想要音视频 + P2P + 很多新功能：
BLIP
我的最终推荐

① LAN Messenger —— 成熟、简单、开箱即用 ② LANChat —— 跨平台、现代、适合二次开发 ③ Mesh-Talk —— 架构先进、安全性最高

text(await tools.exec_command({workdir:"/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029",cmd:`cat > tmp/req-029-landscape.md <<'EOF'
# REQ-029 peer-tool landscape and product requirements

Review date: 2026-11-23. Product baseline: committed \`requirements-work\` at \`0ae1a69261c3fca12bad8bb62021f5fce8d6db2c\`. Historical scope: \`git show 6b28c838^:docs/development-roadmap.md\`. This desk review compares all ten named projects against the committed product, traces recommendations to user jobs and identifies the evidence needed for adoption. Release and source observations are dated. There were no installations, security audits, user interviews, throughput measurements or runtime experiments for this review. Items below are proposals.

## Product decision

Make Mesh Talk the tool a team can install, connect and trust for everyday chat and file handoff on networks it already owns. Start with install-to-first-message, finding the right peer on real LAN/VPN setups, and understanding whether a file got through. Harden already-exposed capabilities. Validate no-install access with narrowly scoped web links. Build bounded voice and native proximity features only for scenarios that justify their ongoing cost. Where a source project makes a broader claim, retain its operating conditions and maturity when deciding what to borrow.

## First-party project review

| Project | Verified from primary sources | Constraints, open claims and lessons |
|---|---|---|
| Columba | Android Reticulum client. Upstream describes LXMF messages, LXST live encrypted calls, BLE, local Wi-Fi, TCP, external RNode for LoRa, local identity generation, identity switching/import/export/QR, optional transport relaying, maps/location and NomadNetwork pages. Reticulum's local AutoInterface uses IPv6 link-local discovery and UDP. | A supported, configured physical path must exist. An external RNode is required for that LoRa route. A project-described low-rate audio profile establishes a feature claim; range, airtime, concurrency, quality and background survival need measurement per configuration. Separate small text delivery, asynchronous speech and live voice. Study reliable identity recovery and explicit route UX before transport adoption. [Columba](https://github.com/torlando-tech/columba) · [Releases](https://github.com/torlando-tech/columba/releases) · [Reticulum interfaces](https://reticulum.network/manual/interfaces.html) · [LXMF](https://github.com/markqvist/LXMF) · [LXST](https://github.com/markqvist/LXST) |
| Bitchat | Apple upstream documents public signed BLE mesh, encrypted private DMs, cached reconciliation, Apple mesh file acceptance with a 1 MiB limit, app-specific Nostr private messaging, and internet-dependent geohash rooms. Android upstream separately describes password-protected topics and supported-device Wi-Fi Aware. | Public BLE and encrypted DM audiences differ. Radio observers can still see metadata; internet geohash channels have a different network model. Validate multi-hop reliability, device mix, private group file behavior and background lifecycle separately. Proximity/onboarding patterns transfer independently of protocol interoperability. [Apple README](https://github.com/permissionlesstech/bitchat) · [Apple whitepaper](https://github.com/permissionlesstech/bitchat/blob/main/WHITEPAPER.md) · [Android](https://github.com/permissionlesstech/bitchat-android) |
| LAN Messenger | Current official site advertises 1.3.27 and installers for Windows, macOS and Linux; the original 1.3.9 snapshot is stale against that page. Upstream lists automatic LAN discovery, direct file transfer, local history, contact groups and targeted/all-network broadcast. Its group-chat window has a leave flow. AES/RSA are declared algorithms. | A contact list grouping differs from membership and permission. Project docs do not establish group file fan-out or saved-by evidence, nor a comparative security ranking. Borrow minimal install-to-first-chat and explicit recipient selection. [Official downloads](https://lanmessenger.github.io/) · [Repository](https://github.com/lanmessenger/lanmessenger) · [Releases](https://github.com/lanmessenger/lanmessenger/releases) · [Group window](https://github.com/lanmessenger/lanmessenger/blob/master/src/gui/chat/chatroomwindow.cpp#L460) |
| LANChat | Upstream describes Rust/Tauri, Axum HTTP/WebSocket web mode, SQLite, UDP discovery, IP/hostname manual discovery across already-routed VLANs/WireGuard, images, chunked transfer, resend on reconnect, Android native share/file flows and optional bot. README lists Windows/Linux/Android/Web. | Browser UI uses an application host, with desktop/web using the same DB layout. Device discovery resides in the native/server process. Reconnect resend does not establish custody after sender power-off. Evaluate mobile file intake and an authorized hosted web session. Reuse Mesh Talk manual addresses and existing native/UI contracts. [Repository and architecture](https://github.com/cap153/LANChat) · [Releases](https://github.com/cap153/LANChat/releases) |
| Mesh Talk | Current public product describes local-first desktop messaging, signed discovery, authenticated Noise transport and end-to-end encrypted chat/file sharing. Baseline has local account creation, DM and invited groups, manual device endpoints, routed discovery, optional post-office custody, folders, verified file completion, account/device linking, backup and experimental direct voice/video. | No cloud registration is required; a local identity and unlock lifecycle still exist. Internet outage on a reachable LAN is different from loss of IP connectivity. Known relay and direct call media capability differ. No comparative security ranking follows from the architecture. [Public project](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk) · [Product site](https://octopusgarage.github.io/mesh-talk/) · [Network contract](../docs/network-design-reference.md) |
| Squiggle | Upstream describes multicast LAN discovery, direct chat/files, voice chat, screen capture and sharing, translation, history, and a cross-subnet bridge. The listed screen module captures and sends screenshots. Its old upstream README describes portable launch and group chat, while the current README describes Linux/macOS assets alongside a Windows target. | Continuous screen streaming, translation backend behavior, plugin availability and feature parity across operating systems require source/release-specific or runtime confirmation. Stars and commit counts provide no acceptance evidence. Compare packaging, bridge setup and screenshot workflow with existing Mesh Talk surfaces. [Current README](https://github.com/hasankhan/Squiggle) · [Historical README](https://github.com/hasankhan/Squiggle/blob/ef61dcc6169af47eb10e275e672d2114c43fdf7c/Readme.md) · [Releases](https://github.com/hasankhan/Squiggle/releases) |
| BeeBEEP | Official archive labels 5.8.6 the stable 5-series version. Legacy material documents local group chat, file/folder flows, voice messages in supported builds, configurable defaults and desktop sharing. The separately documented v6 beta includes member invitation/admin controls, per-recipient offer/progress, resumable transfer and consent rules. | V6 group transfers are individual offers. Direct reachability to the sender is needed for file bytes in its documented flow. A queued offer and a usable copy are different states. Keep legacy and beta security/compatibility claims scoped to the release concerned. Study consent, progress, direct fallback and team deployment. [Legacy downloads](https://www.beebeep.net/legacy/download) · [Legacy help](https://www.beebeep.net/legacy/help) · [Legacy FAQ](https://www.beebeep.net/legacy/faq) · [V6 site](https://www.beebeep.net/) · [Group guide](https://www.beebeep.net/docs/groups) · [File guide](https://www.beebeep.net/docs/files) |
| BLIP | Official repo describes Electron native UDP/mDNS/TCP with WebRTC media, LAN/VPN voice/video, live screen share, beta groups and voice channels, chunked transfer, BEACON seeded files, clipboard scoping, active network diagnostics and optional project workspace. Release page marks 3.0.0 a prerelease, superseding the original snapshot of 2.0 still in development. | Group voice can have a host-centered topology; desktop WebRTC does not imply browser-only P2P. Published file-size settings and documentation are capability leads, not measured throughput. README documents a legacy plaintext compatibility path; signed discovery alone cannot imply a single encryption contract across modes. Compare screensharing, small voice channels, transfer feedback and consented copy. [Repository](https://github.com/krwg/blip) · [Releases](https://github.com/krwg/blip/releases) |
| Technitium Mesh | Identified official Technitium repository. Upstream describes E2E encrypted DMs, groups and files on private LAN or Internet, DHT discovery and Tor onion-service anonymous profiles. Mesh succeeds Bit Chat, whose separately archived source is not the same product. | Tor-based mode requires a functioning Tor route, whereas ordinary LAN mode can stay offline. A DHT creates discovery and bootstrap obligations and cannot create a route through an isolated network. Treat anonymity and metadata statements as vendor claims pending an independent model. Relevant lessons are audience, metadata, trust and profile separation. [Mesh repository](https://github.com/TechnitiumSoftware/Mesh) · [Bit Chat archive](https://github.com/TechnitiumSoftware/BitChatClient) |
| HostTalk | The matching primary source for the supplied name and description is \`tromoSM/HostTalk\`. README describes a local host serving browser chat, a same-Wi-Fi invitation URL and advertised mobile PWA support. No cloud login is claimed. | It depends on a reachable running host and its local port. README does not prove independent browser P2P, E2E confidentiality from the host, HTTPS/PWA parity across mobile browsers, or continued operation when the host sleeps. Borrow one-link access and explicit host status. [Repository](https://github.com/tromoSM/HostTalk) · [Releases](https://github.com/tromoSM/HostTalk/releases) |

## Scenarios and operating boundaries

| Environment | Representative job | Existing base and highest-value unknown |
|---|---|---|
| Reachable LAN, Internet unavailable | Office, lab or workshop can start a conversation and deliver a document | Native messaging works within a reachable IP boundary. Measure clean first use, local-network permission, multicast-restricted paths, consent and saved-byte comprehension. |
| Routed VLANs or a permitted VPN | Connect a known colleague across sites | Manual endpoint, routed discovery and authorized post-office federation exist. Measure instructions, endpoint verification, policies and feature-specific reachability. An accepted introduction establishes neither TCP reachability nor a media path. |
| Recipient temporarily offline | Handoff completes after interruption | Direct resend, authorized peer copies and configured custody have distinct conditions. Measure sender-off before and after a complete deposit, refusal and recovery when only some bytes are retained. |
| Guest can open a browser on a reachable LAN | Review one document without installing software | A scoped link needs host availability, dedicated authority, expiry/revocation and trusted origin. A full paired browser client adds key/storage and lifecycle decisions. |
| No reachable IP path, but compatible devices are nearby | Deliver a brief urgent update | The native Bluetooth rehearsal is scoped to encrypted macOS direct-link echo using pre-exchanged keys. Product text, cross-platform, multi-hop and locked/background behavior need independent evidence. |
| Wide-area constrained or intermittent radio | Relay small updates between known groups | Columba provides an external RNode/Reticulum precedent. Path reliability, hardware availability, power, local radio constraints and payload budgeting determine feasibility. |
| Groups need live collaboration | Explain a problem in a call or by sharing a window | Existing experimental 1:1 calls have split Noise signaling and WebRTC media reachability. Screenshots already have their own workflow. Verify direct voice/video first, then screen presentation or small group voice where demand is observed. |

Primary product contracts: [first run](../docs/help/topics/first-run.md), [routed networks](../docs/help/topics/routed-networks.md), [channels](../docs/help/topics/channels.md), [files](../docs/help/topics/send-files.md), [network design](../docs/network-design-reference.md), [calls](../docs/help/topics/calls.md), [native BLE](../docs/native-bluetooth.md), [privacy](../docs/privacy-controls.md), [module owners](../docs/module-boundaries.md).

## Requirements inventory

Priorities are qualitative. **P1** is a current product flow worth measuring and improving when an observed defect or friction merits a change. **P2** warrants scoped product discovery or a contained prototype. **P3** needs a stronger use case or a platform/topology prerequisite before prototype investment. **Defer** means a specific proposal currently lacks fit or a safe sustainable operating model. Effort **S/M/L** estimates boundary scope only: one existing workflow, multiple owners/native platforms, or a new authority/transport/product surface. Historical REQ IDs preserve ownership, not implementation authorization.
EOF`}))

### P1 | Improve current jobs

| ID / effort | Requirement and peer signal | First slice, acceptance evidence and ownership |
|---|---|---|
| 01 / M | **First-use offline onboarding.** LAN Messenger, BeeBEEP and historical Squiggle suggest an install-and-discover benchmark. Mesh Talk already creates a local protected identity and signs in. | Test clean installations without internet. Explain local identity in one step, then show discovery, permission or app-firewall outcome and a known-peer alternative. Measure install-to-first-verified-message time, interventions and completion by OS. Keep recovery and key continuity visible. [First run](../docs/help/topics/first-run.md) |
| 02 / M | **Connection diagnosis and manual address UX.** LANChat and Squiggle show the value of connecting across an already-reachable routed network. Mesh Talk already has diagnostics, manual device addresses and routed discovery. | Present discovery, peer verification, direct route, relay route and media route as separate evidence when applicable. Provide actions for blocked multicast, stale endpoint and client isolation. Validate same-LAN and physical VLAN/VPN paths with and without advertised peers. Reuse route and diagnostics owners. [Routed networks](../docs/help/topics/routed-networks.md) · [Diagnostics](../docs/help/topics/diagnostics.md) |
| 03 / M | **File handoff evidence.** BeeBEEP per-member status and LANChat transfer phases provide a comparison. Mesh Talk already has exact consent/completion controls and group copy information. | Start by testing comprehensibility and exposing evidence already available to the sender. Show remote completion only when the exact authorized proof exists; show received card, waiting consent/data, authorized eligible source, unreachable source and local save failure accurately. Group copy count does not establish who saved bytes. Any new disclosure uses account-scoped membership and explicitly addresses multi-device semantics. [File network contracts](../docs/network-design-reference.md) · [Group file delivery](../docs/help/topics/channels.md#file-delivery) |
| 04 / M | **Reliable file and folder batches.** LANChat, BeeBEEP and BLIP provide comparison points for large and interrupted transfers. Mesh Talk already supports encrypted chunking and safe directory extraction. | Benchmark current flow under interruption, low disk, write denial, same-name files, old clients and sender/recipient restart. Compare bytes, elapsed time, peak memory/spool use, retry behavior and return to idle. Add a unified progress/cancel/retry view only for a measured gap. Keep message delivery responsive during transfer. [Architecture](../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) · [Files](../docs/help/topics/send-files.md) |
| 05 / M | **Make offline delivery predictable.** LANChat's reconnect resend and BeeBEEP's queued offers demonstrate different promises. Configured Mesh Talk post offices and eligible member copies can supply retained events independently of immediate sender availability. | Show whether a specific offer or the necessary bytes have eligible custody, whether the recipient still needs to consent, and whether re-opening the sender is required. Test sender off before/after deposit, expired/evicted custody and disabled permissions. Reuse bounded scheduling and existing delivery semantics. [Post offices](../docs/help/topics/post-offices.md) · [Network design](../docs/network-design-reference.md) |
| 06 / M | **Harden existing direct voice/video.** Columba, Squiggle and BLIP provide independent product references. Committed Mesh Talk has experimental 1:1 calls and local media checks. | Qualify real compatible calls on representative desktop OS pairs, LAN and permitted VPN; compare signaling failures, advancing audio/video, output selection, camera fallback, reconnect, lock/logout cleanup and idle load. Promotion requires successful native evidence and understood failure behavior. [Calls](../docs/help/topics/calls.md) |
| 07 / M | **Repeatable offline site deployment.** LAN Messenger installers, BeeBEEP portable/configuration paths and Squiggle self-contained packages are useful implementation comparisons. Mesh Talk already ships desktop/relay packages and service runbooks. | Produce an offline install/update and restore acceptance path using existing signed packages. Verify no internet, checksum/signature, local permissions, preserved identity/trust, policy choices and rollback. Consider managed defaults only after measuring repeat-site friction, and never import an unreviewed trust grant. Coordinate with REQ-014. [Updates](../docs/updates.md) · [Post-office releases](../docs/post-office-release.md) |
| 08 / S–M | **Explain network privacy at the action that needs it.** Columba identity UX, Bitchat public/private channels and Technitium profile choices show why visibility, admission and authority need clear product language. | On shared Wi-Fi verify unknown peer, verified peer and locked/invisible behavior. Label what discovery exposes, when a peer can contact the account, who can access content, and why relay discovery is separately opted in. Improve existing trust/QR/check and privacy affordances if evidence shows confusion. REQ-013/018/025. [Privacy](../docs/privacy-controls.md) · [Peer trust](../docs/peer-trust.md) |

### P2 | Focused discovery or prototype

| ID / effort | Requirement and peer signal | First slice and gate |
|---|---|---|
| 09 / M | **Asynchronous voice notes.** BeeBEEP shows a lightweight alternative for a handoff that is easier to speak. | Explicit record, duration/size cap, preview, discard and consented playback using existing encrypted attachment lifecycle. Measure use against text and a live call. Release microphone on every exit. Dictation, transcripts and PTT have different requirements. |
| 10 / M | **1:1 live screen presentation.** BLIP describes live WebRTC sharing. Squiggle documents a screenshot module; Mesh Talk already has screenshot capture/edit/send. | Start with a user-picked window or screen during an authenticated existing call, with an always-visible sharing state and explicit stop. Validate OS capture permission, lock/hangup, captured-window close, stopped or black stream and bandwidth. Scope system audio and remote control separately. [Screenshots](../docs/help/topics/screenshots.md) · [W3C Screen Capture](https://www.w3.org/TR/screen-capture/) |
| 11 / L | **Small group voice.** BLIP group voice and Columba/LXST are precedents for different topologies. | Under REQ-023, start with voluntary join into an existing authenticated group and an explicitly bounded participant count. Compare peer mesh and host fan-out before selection. Validate membership changes, initiator departure, device permissions, interrupted sessions, audible media, bandwidth/CPU and cleanup. Existing post offices provide neither live signaling nor media bridging. |
| 12 / L | **Browser guest review link.** HostTalk and LANChat show low-friction browser access to a local host. | Under REQ-002, share one approved piece of content read-only first; add scoped comments after the need and authorship model are clear. Verify trusted HTTPS origin, review-host/key authority, expiry, revocation and host unavailability. A reachable link must not grant membership, identity keys, history search or arbitrary files. [Secure contexts](https://www.w3.org/TR/secure-contexts/) |
| 13 / M–L | **Lightweight task/shift groups.** LAN Messenger window departure and BeeBEEP invites suggest an opportunity to reduce temporary setup and cleanup work. Mesh Talk already has account membership and configurable invited text history. | Test fast reuse of trusted contacts, explicit invitation and a local archive/close workflow first. Ask which data should remain. Prototype timed membership or new automatic expiry only after defining offline enforcement, old clients, saved copies, backups and behavior after owner departure. REQ-018. |
| 14 / M | **Targeted one-off announcement and acknowledgment.** LAN Messenger's selected recipients are useful contrast to Mesh Talk's owner-published group announcement and existing forwarding. | Count recurring cases where the sender knows the recipients yet would create throwaway groups or send duplicate DMs. Preview a bounded recipient set and use explicit send confirmation. Define human acknowledgment separately if the task requires it. Preserve admission, batch retry and per-recipient privacy. [Channels](../docs/help/topics/channels.md) · [Forwarding](../docs/message-forwarding.md) |
| 15 / M | **Group handoff bundle for late joiners.** BeeBEEP file offers and BLIP seeded libraries highlight the reuse need. Existing Mesh Talk initial invite history is bounded text, and newer members do not automatically receive old file cards or keys. | Start with owner selects files explicitly, visible source/expiry and an authorized new handoff, building on attachment forwarding where applicable. Test protected content, prior members who left, a source disappearing and post-office availability. REQ-018. [Channels](../docs/help/topics/channels.md) |
| 16 / S–M | **Explicit copy/send to my linked device or chosen peer.** BLIP clipboard scoping exposes a useful transfer job and a plaintext exposure risk. Mesh Talk has Message Yourself and local clipboard controls. | Use a user-triggered send, preview recipient and text/image, then employ current E2E transport and protected-content rules. Avoid polling the OS clipboard; test denial, logout, device removal and retention. Measure whether Message Yourself already meets the goal. [Clipboard and privacy](../docs/privacy-controls.md) |
| 17 / M | **Portable team setup and authorized relay health.** BeeBEEP config and headless LANChat are precedents for managing multiple installations. Mesh Talk already has service packages and post-office diagnostics. | Validate a profile containing safe defaults or approved relay addresses. Show bounded non-content diagnostics such as capacity, retention, service freshness and expected route policy. Preserve explicit user approval of identity/trust and prove no secret or recipient metadata leakage. Prefer existing operators and local controls. |
| 18 / M | **Mobile share/receive workflow discovery.** LANChat's Android share intents and SAF flows demonstrate concrete tasks. | Test camera-to-chat and share-from-files with offline LAN recipients. Compare an authorized host-backed browser, native mobile client, and existing desktop intake. Require source handle access, save/reveal, permission suspension and restart evidence. This informs REQ-027 or a separately justified native client. |
| 19 / M | **Bounded maintenance and active diagnostics.** BLIP offers heartbeat visibility. Mesh Talk already monitors routes and resource behavior. | Test whether explicit active path check, recent error interpretation and sanitized support export reduce troubleshooting time. Reuse REQ-001/011/016 and existing event owners. Record startup, settled idle, active work and return to idle. Add periodic work only if an observed user need cannot be met by current observations. [Performance requirements](../docs/performance-requirements.md) |
| 20 / M | **Opt-in bot or operator automation.** LANChat's LANClaw and BeeBEEP scripting suggest lab alerting or structured handoff. Mesh Talk already has scoped local agent access, bot host and MCP. | Pick a real consumer performing a bounded task through a named grant. Require target scoping, auditability, rate/storage caps, revocation and no need for account secrets. Reuse integrations and require explicit authorization for actions. No second scripting runtime without a demonstrated gap. [Bot integrations](../docs/bot-integrations.md) |

### P3 | Strategic options with explicit prerequisites

| ID / effort | Option and peer signal | Activation condition and first test |
|---|---|---|
| 21 / L | **Paired browser/PWA client.** LANChat, HostTalk and REQ-027. | Define a recurring mobile chat job beyond single-file guest access, the authorized host and whether it may read plaintext, pairing and key ownership, browser cache/logouts and host-off behavior. Validate iOS Safari and Android browsers on a trusted origin, storage loss, reconnection and background suspension. Service worker cache covers application assets; message transport still needs a path. [Service Workers](https://w3c.github.io/ServiceWorker/) |
| 22 / L | **Native mobile client.** Columba, Bitchat and LANChat. | Activate for recurring tasks that require LAN discovery, sharing, notifications or radio behavior the browser cannot deliver. Define account/device link and revocation, install/update, app lifecycle, local-key storage and battery baseline before assuming reuse or starting an SDK. REQ-020/021 need a real consumer. |
| 23 / L | **Native BLE direct text bridge within Mesh Talk.** Bitchat/Columba provide context; repo already has macOS direct-link rehearsal. | Start with two physical hosts, pre-verified contacts, bounded text and IP disabled. Verify link drop/reconnect, identity mismatch, consent, permission, background/locked behavior, memory/battery and route preference. Existing bounded Noise adapter owns transport; PWA and multi-hop are independent. [Native Bluetooth](../docs/native-bluetooth.md) |
| 24 / L | **Multi-hop or Wi-Fi Aware under absent-LAN conditions.** Bitchat and Reticulum. | Require a recurring communication scenario with compatible physical devices and direct-link range limitations. Test three physical nodes including intermediary drop, duplicate/replay control, expiry, loop prevention, bounded forwarding and default opt-out. Measure energy, interference and node availability. Distinguish native capabilities from permissions on each target. |
| 25 / L | **Reticulum/LXMF and external RNode/LoRa interop.** Columba. | Require an actual hardware user/partner and a link budget. Prototype short consented text/status with opt-in relay only. Define encryption termination, peer/key mapping, metadata, legal/regional review, acknowledgments, queue expiry, throughput and power on configured hardware. An adapter cannot implicitly extend chat audience or security claims. Evaluate live voice only after direct text and audio measurements in the target setup. |
| 26 / L | **Internet/NAT traversal or operator-run media relay.** BLIP shows the reachable-network WebRTC baseline; Technitium shows a different Internet path. | Require cross-site live calls that fail on current approved networks. Compare direct routing/VPN with explicitly administered STUN/TURN where needed; verify media reachability, data retention, authentication, abuse limits, cost and fallback when services fail. REQ-007/013/023. |
| 27 / L | **Small group video, independent voice rooms, PTT or live system audio.** BLIP voice channels and Columba calls offer precedent. | Change only after direct call or small-group audio acceptance and an established use case. Assess different participant admission, capture/lock cleanup, bandwidth, device load and moderation. Give PTT separate half-duplex and delivery semantics. |
| 28 / L | **Shared file catalog and multi-source retrieval.** BLIP BEACON is a useful comparison to bounded, authorized group copies. | Activate for repeated file reuse where an explicitly republished bundle fails. Define publisher rights, visibility, dedup and integrity; capacity and source availability must be visible and bounded. No opt-out-only disk seeding. Coordinate REQ-018 and, where allocation is real, REQ-028. |
| 29 / L | **Shared notes or document collaboration.** BLIP Pad/board/canvas and HostTalk access. | Validate scoped document review first under REQ-002. Consider a versioned, conflict-aware note for a specific task. Decide authorship, offline conflict recovery, permission revocation and export before feature parity with pads, kanban or canvases. |
| 30 / M | **Language help and optional local transcription.** Squiggle translation and BeeBEEP/Columba audio. | Establish repeated multilingual/audio access need. Pilot a user-selected message or voice note with explicit processing destination, no default network disclosure, language/accuracy checks and a measured model/package budget. Treat source text and generated summary as different records. |
| 31 / L | **Separate identity profiles and portable recovery.** Columba and Technitium support multiple identities; Mesh Talk already has backup and device linking. | Start with separation of real work/personal identities when observed, preserving local authentication and per-profile storage, keys, notifications and authorized device linking. Treat external identity import as security and protocol work; compare a contact export or native backup UX first. |
| 32 / M–L | **Selective location or local presence context.** Columba shares encrypted location and offline maps; Bitchat geo rooms follow a separate Internet path. | Require a specific coordination use case. Begin with one user-approved point and recipient list. Evaluate coarse precision, expiry, no public discovery leakage and offline map sizes/licensing. Continuous location, proximity claims and public map rooms require a separate decision. |
| 33 / M–L | **Searchable bounded activity and user-authorized export.** LAN Messenger and Squiggle local history, BLIP search/export and project records. | Test current history, search, favorites, forwarding and encrypted backup before adding a workflow. If external handoff needs an export, define what users may export, protected/expired content handling, local audit and custody boundaries. Coordinate REQ-017. |
| 34 / L | **Scoped public or guest discovery.** Bitchat public proximity chat and LAN Messenger broadcasts highlight a different audience model. | Require repeated stranger/guest encounter and a moderation owner. Prototype invitation- or QR-gated, time-bounded access before any discoverable channel, with blocks, rate limits and consent. REQ-019/024/025/026 keep public publishing, trust and per-post private audience independent. |

### Defer on present evidence

| ID / effort | Proposal | Rationale and revisit trigger |
|---|---|---|
| 35 / M–L | **Background system clipboard synchronization or shared clipboard history.** | System clipboard can hold credentials or protected data, and watch loops consume idle budget. Revisit only after explicit linked-device send proves insufficient for a high-frequency job and an opt-in owner scopes types, authorizations and retention. |
| 36 / L | **Default public DHT, global directory or Tor anonymization.** | Technitium addresses Internet anonymity. For current private LAN teams, expanding discovery introduces bootstrap, traffic exposure, abuse and identity-continuity costs. Revisit only for a documented privacy/network model and real users. |
| 37 / L | **LAN-wide default blast, anonymous open chat, mandatory shared service.** | Conflicts with explicit admission and peer-operated design in current scenarios. Emergency or facility broadcast, if required, needs an administering authority, clear scope and separate abuse/availability review. |
| 38 / L | **Indiscriminate interoperability, change of runtime, or feature copying.** | Tauri vs Electron, directory protocols, product rankings and vanity metrics are implementation comparisons. Adopt isolated improvements through existing owners, and require a genuine external client or verified bottleneck before a new protocol/language/platform rewrite. |
| 39 / M–L | **Points, paid feature tiers, automatic replication and always-on plugins.** | BLIP optional tier and workspace establish product experiments. Revisit resources/incentives under REQ-028 when optional capacity is actually scarce and fairness is observable. Use explicit grants and existing bot integration for concrete automation. |

## Order of evidence and decisions

1. **Baseline the everyday jobs.** On clean profiles and warmed profiles, measure first-message success/time, failed step and independent peer verification with internet disabled. Repeat on a shared LAN with discovery blocked and on an approved routed/VPN path. Validate real desynchronized clocks or Wi-Fi changes only where the scenario requires them. Compare unchanged baseline first.
2. **Run a four-account handoff.** Sender, two accepted recipients and a visible nonmember. Have one recipient decline or disconnect depending on run; record card arrival, approval, verified bytes and local save plus sender interpretation independently. Repeat permitted sender-off cases with complete/incomplete custody, late join and a failed destination write. Compare throughput, CPU/memory/storage/battery and return to idle for small, large and folder workloads. Existing physical results in the network guide can be cited with their exact topology, build and file size.
3. **Qualify current media before expanding media.** Real two-host voice and video on the target OS matrix. Capture live audible/decoded media and route evidence, permission failures and device cleanup. A screenshot, app-loopback media check or successful chat does not substitute for this qualification.
4. **Prototype only the differentiated surface needed for a validated job.** Compare short voice note vs synchronous call, full install vs scoped browser review, current group vs quick selection, and existing folder transfer vs a specialized transfer view. Require better task completion with current authority preserved before selecting the next implementation.
5. **Treat no-IP connectivity as its own discovery track.** Establish hardware availability and the user urgency/message-size need; use native direct BLE as the first practical alternative only if suitable. Test multi-hop, radio and external protocol adapter as distinct hypotheses. Define a failure budget before any adoption.
6. **Require closure evidence per selected item.** Name its owner, exact authority boundary, acceptance criteria and positive/negative/recovery scenarios. Measure startup, active path, return to idle and long-tail resource reclamation as applicable. Record cases intentionally not exercised, particularly SSL retrieval, certificate trust, OS permissions, sender-off custody, old-client compatibility, native sleep and physical RF.

## Traceability

- First-use, installation, account and trust: 01, 07, 08, 17, 31. Discovery/topology/recovery: 02, 05, 19, 23–26, 36. Files/images/folders/large data: 03–05, 15, 18, 28. Group/selection and collaboration: 10–15, 27, 29, 32–34, 37. Voice, camera and screen: 06, 09–11, 25–27. Browser/mobile: 12, 18, 21–22. Clipboard, translation and extensibility: 16, 20, 30, 35, 38–39.
- Further evidence for group and attachment behavior is in [peer evidence](req-029-peer-evidence.md). The [first scenario note](req-029-analysis.md) records the narrower starting hypothesis.

content.text:
我把 REQ-029 做成了一份完整的竞品调研和需求清单，覆盖你列出的 **10 个项目、7 类使用环境和 39 项需求建议**。每项都记录了 Mesh Talk 的现有能力、值得做的部分、首个可验证范围、依赖和暂缓条件。基线是 `req-029` worktree 的 `0ae1a692`。本轮核对了官方文档、发布页和相关源码，没有安装竞品、实测性能或验证用户需求。[完整调研与需求清单](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029/tmp/req-029-landscape.md)

**我的建议是先把 Mesh Talk 做成小团队在自有网络上能快速用起来、出故障能自己判断、交付文件能确认结果的通信工具。** 最值得优先推进的是首次离线上手、连接诊断、文件交付和离线接续。扩展方向里，浏览器免安装审阅、异步语音消息和一对一屏幕共享最值得独立验证。无 IP 网络通信有潜在价值，应该按 BLE、无线多跳和外接 LoRa 分别立项验证。

## 十个项目分别值得借鉴什么

| 项目 | 核查结果与对 Mesh Talk 的启发 |
|---|---|
| **Columba** | 官方 Android 项目明确支持 LXMF 消息、LXST 实时语音、BLE、Wi‑Fi、TCP，以及通过外接 **RNode** 的 LoRa。也有本地身份、QR、身份切换与迁移、位置和离线地图。最值得借鉴的是**按链路能力提供不同通信方式**。项目文档描述了低带宽语音配置，具体距离、通话质量、并发和后台可用性仍需在目标硬件上测量。 [Columba](https://github.com/torlando-tech/columba) · [Reticulum 接口](https://reticulum.network/manual/interfaces.html) · [LXST](https://github.com/markqvist/LXST) |
| **Bitchat** | Apple 版公开 BLE 群聊和加密私信有不同的受众与安全边界。Apple 白皮书描述了上限 1 MiB 的 mesh 文件，Android 另有受支持硬件上的 Wi‑Fi Aware 和密码频道。Nostr 地理频道需要互联网。值得借鉴的是**附近设备发现、链路中断后的补齐和小消息预算**，跨客户端私密群文件的行为仍需验证。 [Apple 白皮书](https://github.com/permissionlesstech/bitchat/blob/main/WHITEPAPER.md) · [Android](https://github.com/permissionlesstech/bitchat-android) |
| **LAN Messenger** | 官网当前列出 **1.3.27**，原材料的 1.3.9 已过时。官方资料确认桌面安装包、局域网发现、文件、历史和指定对象广播。适合用来对照**安装到首聊的步骤**及**临时选人通知**。文档中的加密算法名称不足以建立安全排名。 [官网](https://lanmessenger.github.io/) · [源码](https://github.com/lanmessenger/lanmessenger) · [发行页](https://github.com/lanmessenger/lanmessenger/releases) |
| **LANChat** | 确认 Rust/Tauri、SQLite、UDP 发现、HTTP/WebSocket Web 模式、手动 IP/主机名发现、分块文件、重连接续和 Android 分享入口。**浏览器使用本地宿主**，原生端或服务负责发现。可借鉴移动文件入口、传输阶段的提示和宿主部署。Mesh Talk 已支持手动地址与路由发现。 [源码与架构](https://github.com/cap153/LANChat) |
| **Mesh Talk** | 当前基线已有本地身份、签名发现、Noise、受邀群、文件夹传输、精确文件完成控制、可选邮局托管、设备绑定与备份，以及实验性一对一语音和视频。无厂商注册仍有本地身份和解锁流程。接下来最有价值的是**降低现有能力的使用成本和判断成本**。 [项目](https://github.com/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk) · [官网](https://octopusgarage.github.io/mesh-talk/) · [网络设计](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029/docs/network-design-reference.md) |
| **Squiggle** | 上游列有文件、语音、历史、翻译、跨子网桥接和屏幕捕获，屏幕模块明确描述了截图发送。持续屏幕串流和各平台的插件、媒体功能齐备程度仍需验证。适合比较**部署、桥接和截图工作流**。 [源码](https://github.com/hasankhan/Squiggle) · [发行页](https://github.com/hasankhan/Squiggle/releases) |
| **BeeBEEP** | **5.8.6 是官网归档的稳定版，6 是 beta。** 6 的文档描述逐成员文件邀约、进度、同意和续传，文件字节仍依赖发送方直连。最值得借鉴的是**逐接收方讲清文件进展**，再结合 Mesh Talk 已有的授权成员供件和邮局托管。 [稳定版](https://www.beebeep.net/legacy/download) · [群组指南](https://www.beebeep.net/docs/groups) · [文件指南](https://www.beebeep.net/docs/files) |
| **BLIP** | 原材料的「2.0 仍在开发」已不足以描述现状，发行页已有 **3.0.0 预发布**。上游列有 LAN/VPN 音视频、实时屏幕共享、beta 群组、带宿主的语音频道、大文件、BEACON 文件目录、剪贴板和项目协作。值得借鉴的是**屏幕呈现、文件交付界面和小规模语音**。大小设置不能当作吞吐实测，旧版明文兼容与新握手也须分别评估。 [源码](https://github.com/krwg/blip) · [发行页](https://github.com/krwg/blip/releases) |
| **Technitium Mesh** | 找到了官方仓库。上游描述 DHT 发现、私信、群聊、文件，以及使用 Tor onion service 的匿名身份。Tor 模式需要可达的 Tor 路径。对 Mesh Talk 最有价值的是**身份分离和元数据边界**，当前私有局域网场景尚无引入公共 DHT 的依据。 [Technitium Mesh](https://github.com/TechnitiumSoftware/Mesh) · [前代 Bit Chat](https://github.com/TechnitiumSoftware/BitChatClient) |
| **HostTalk** | 与原材料描述匹配的上游是 `tromoSM/HostTalk`。它由一台局域网宿主提供浏览器聊天和邀请地址，README 声明支持移动 PWA。值得学的是**一条链接就能开始**。宿主休眠、浏览器 HTTPS/PWA 兼容、宿主能否读内容，都需要各自验证。 [HostTalk](https://github.com/tromoSM/HostTalk) |

## 建议需求清单

优先级按**用户任务价值、现有能力复用、权限与维护成本、证据成熟度**排列。这里的优先级是调研建议，实施前先确认实际缺口。

### P1 · 优先改善现有流程

| # | 需求 | 做到什么程度 |
|---|---|---|
| 01 | **离线首次上手** | 在无互联网的干净机器上，从安装、本地身份到发现并联系正确的人。记录耗时、失败步骤和是否需要人工指导。 |
| 02 | **连接诊断与手动地址体验** | 从用户操作上讲清「已发现」「身份已验证」「能直连」「可经邮局」「通话媒体可达」，给出与失败阶段对应的下一步。 |
| 03 | **文件交付状态** | 先用现有证据呈现卡片到达、待审批、字节可获取、校验完成和本地保存。群里可见的副本确认和逐成员完成需要分别表达。 |
| 04 | **大文件、文件夹及批量传输体验** | 基于现有分块和安全解包，验证大文件、目录、重启、低磁盘、写入失败和命名冲突。测到缺口再补统一的进度、取消和重试。 |
| 05 | **离线交付与恢复可预期** | 发件人能判断是否还需要保持在线。验证内容完整托管前后、接收方拒绝、托管过期或来源丢失时的行为。 |
| 06 | **验证现有一对一通话** | 用真实桌面双机测语音、视频、摄像头失败、VPN 路径和挂断后的设备释放，再决定是否扩大默认开放范围。 |
| 07 | **可重复的断网部署和更新** | 用现有签名包验证离线安装、升级、回滚和恢复，覆盖防火墙、局域网权限和身份保留。衔接 REQ-014。 |
| 08 | **在关键动作解释身份和隐私** | 在找人、验证联系人、入群和启用邮局时，让用户知道谁能发现自己、谁能联系自己、谁能访问内容。衔接 REQ-013/018/025。 |

### P2 · 值得做小范围验证

| # | 需求 | 首个范围 |
|---|---|---|
| 09 | **异步语音消息** | 显式录音、预览、丢弃、时长限制和接收控制。适合对方不在线、文字又难以说清的交接。 |
| 10 | **一对一实时共享屏幕** | 从现有通话中选择窗口或屏幕，持续显示共享状态，随时停止。先验证权限、黑屏、锁定和挂断。 |
| 11 | **小群语音** | 从现有群里自愿加入、有限人数开始。验证发起者退出、成员移除、实际媒体及资源占用。沿用 REQ-023。 |
| 12 | **浏览器免安装审阅** | 先分享一份明确选中的内容，短期只读、可撤销。再根据需求加评论。沿用 REQ-002。 |
| 13 | **临时任务群** | 先验证快速选人、邀请和归档。只有用户确实需要时，才定义自动到期，以及历史、已下载文件和备份的保留语义。 |
| 14 | **定向一次性通知** | 面向明确选中的联系人，发送前预览受众。有明确业务需要时再加主动确认，并保留每个人的接触权限。 |
| 15 | **给迟到成员的交接包** | 由有权成员明确重发选定文件，包含来源和可用期。新成员入群和可见早期文本本身不授予过去的附件访问权。 |
| 16 | **显式发送剪贴板内容** | 用户选中内容并预览后，发送给自己的已绑定设备或指定联系人。先看现有「发给自己」能覆盖多少需求。 |
| 17 | **团队部署配置与邮局健康** | 可审查的默认值、地址和运行状态。保留显式信任确认，健康视图以容量、保留和连通性为主。 |
| 18 | **移动端分享与接收** | 从相机或系统分享菜单发文件、接收并保存。用真实任务比较宿主式 Web 和原生客户端。 |
| 19 | **主动诊断与可分享的支持信息** | 优先提供按需路径检查、读得懂的近期错误和脱敏导出，复用现有观测，避免为状态界面增加常驻探测。 |
| 20 | **受控机器人与运维动作** | 选一个真实用途，如在实验室群发有来源的状态通知。复用现有 bot/MCP 授权，验证目标范围、撤销和资源限制。 |

### P3 · 保留方向，满足条件后再投入

| # | 需求 | 启动条件 |
|---|---|---|
| 21 | **已配对浏览器/PWA 客户端** | 已有持续移动聊天需求，并明确宿主信任、密钥归属、浏览器存储及断开宿主后的行为。沿用 REQ-027。 |
| 22 | **原生移动客户端** | 发现、系统分享、通知或无线能力有明确需求，且需要原生生命周期与权限支持。 |
| 23 | **无 IP 时的原生 BLE 直连文本** | 先用现有双 Mac rehearsal 做基础，验证两台实体设备、已验证联系人、短文本、重连、拒绝和后台行为。 |
| 24 | **BLE 多跳或 Wi‑Fi Aware** | 直连距离确实无法满足任务，并且有兼容设备。先做三节点和中继退出验证，明确转发预算、延迟和功耗。 |
| 25 | **Reticulum/LXMF、外接 RNode/LoRa** | 有实际硬件使用者和场景。先验证短文本、身份映射、同意、保留、硬件与地区约束，再评估音频。 |
| 26 | **跨 NAT 通话及自管媒体中继** | 当前路由/VPN 路径确实挡住跨站点通话，再比较直连与由操作者部署的 STUN/TURN，验证成本、认证和故障回退。 |
| 27 | **群视频、独立语音房、PTT、共享系统音频** | 先通过已有直连通话和小群语音验证。分别定义参与者准入、采集、资源和权限。 |
| 28 | **受权文件目录与多源提取** | 文件被频繁复用，交接包已不足。先解决发布权、范围、来源在线、配额、过期和完整性。 |
| 29 | **共享笔记或文档协作** | 浏览器审阅证明用户需要共同修改。先做一个有版本和冲突处理的笔记任务，再决定看板或画布是否有价值。 |
| 30 | **按需翻译与本地转录** | 有持续多语或音频可访问需求。明确处理位置、内容授权、准确度、包体和运行成本。 |
| 31 | **工作/私人身份分离与可迁移恢复** | 用户确实需要在同机隔离多个身份。验证密钥、通知、备份和绑定设备各自隔离。 |
| 32 | **按次位置分享与离线地图** | 有实际协作定位需求。从手动选点、指定接收人和有效期开始。 |
| 33 | **可搜索的交接记录与授权导出** | 现有历史、收藏、转发和备份仍满足不了复盘或交接。先定义保护内容、到期和外部副本行为。 |
| 34 | **受控访客与附近发现** | 有确凿的陌生人或访客协作场景，也有负责准入与管理的人。优先验证二维码或短期邀请。 |

**当前暂缓的五项**是后台剪贴板同步、公共 DHT/Tor 路径、默认全网广播或开放匿名房、无具体消费者的协议互通或框架更换，以及积分分层、自动扩散复制和常驻插件。完整报告为这五项分别列了重启条件。它们的成本主要落在权限、元数据、后台资源和长期运维，当前证据还撑不起投入。[暂缓项及重启条件](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029/tmp/req-029-landscape.md)

## 我会怎样选第一批

1. **先用同一个测试环境跑两条基线。** 断开互联网，分别测试干净安装到首条私信，以及已安装用户在受限组播和已路由 VPN 上遇到的连接失败。记录每次卡住的位置。优先修阻断用户任务的步骤。

下面是 REQ-029 的完整清单。**34 项有具体用户价值的需求**按推进顺序排列，另列 **5 项目前值得暂缓的提案**。每项都写了可以做到哪一步。这里的编号是 REQ-029 内部清单编号，已有独立 REQ 的事项继续沿用原编号。

**如果只选一项先做，我选 03「文件交付状态」，同时用 04、05 的失败和恢复场景验收。** Mesh Talk 已有文件夹传输、接收审批、校验和完成凭证。要解决的具体问题是：**发件人能不能知道对方已经拿到了可用文件？如果还没有，双方知不知道下一步该做什么？**

## 一、近期最值得做 · 8 项

| # | 具体需求 | 第一版做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| **01** | **断网也能顺利完成首次上手** | 让新用户从离线安装包创建本地身份、找到同伴并发出第一条私信。发现失败时，直接给出局域网权限、防火墙或手动添加地址入口。用干净安装记录成功率、耗时和卡住的步骤。 |
| **02** | **看得懂的连接诊断** | 在联系人或连接页说明当前能确认什么：已发现设备、身份已验证、直连可达、可经邮局、媒体路径未知。提供对应操作，如重新检查、添加地址或查看权限。覆盖同一 LAN、受限组播和已路由 VPN。 |
| **03** | **文件交到了哪一步** | 发件人能分清文件邀约已到达、等待对方同意、字节传输中、已有完成凭证和状态未知。接收人能分清等待来源、下载中、校验完成、保存失败和已保存。群聊只展示有凭证支持的结果。 |
| **04** | **批量文件和文件夹可恢复传输** | 给一批文件一个可查看的进度入口，支持定位失败项、取消和单项重试。先用现有传输验证大文件、低磁盘、同名文件、目录解包失败和双方重启，补实际缺的操作。 |
| **05** | **知道离线交付还需要谁在线** | 发送端能看出文件内容是否已完整托管，接收端能看出是在等批准、等授权来源，还是已有可恢复副本。覆盖发送端提前关机、托管到期、来源消失和替代来源恢复。 |
| **06** | **把已有一对一语音和视频做可靠** | 优先让用户拨通、听见、看见、知道失败原因，并在挂断后释放麦克风和摄像头。用真实双机验证 LAN、可达 VPN、设备切换、拒绝权限和音频回退，再决定是否默认开放。 |
| **07** | **隔离网络可交付的安装和更新流程** | 用现有签名安装包建立断网安装、校验、升级、回滚和恢复流程。在目标系统上验证原身份、信任关系和历史随升级保留。 |
| **08** | **在关键动作讲清身份、可见性和权限** | 在发现、验证联系人、入群和启用邮局时，明确谁能看见我、谁能联系我、谁能访问内容。扩展现有 QR、联系人验证和隐私入口，尤其验证共享 Wi‑Fi 上的陌生账号。 |

## 二、值得做小版本验证 · 12 项

| # | 具体需求 | 第一版做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| **09** | **异步语音消息** | 录一段短语音，发送前可试听、删除或重录；接收端按现有附件规则下载和播放。适合值班交接和说起来比写更快的内容。 |
| **10** | **一对一通话中实时共享窗口或屏幕** | 从现有通话里选择一个窗口或屏幕，持续显示「正在共享」并可立即停止。先覆盖权限拒绝、窗口关闭、黑屏、锁屏和挂断。 |
| **11** | **现有群里的小规模语音会话** | 已入群的成员自愿加入，可以静音、离开和重新加入。首版限定人数，比较参与者直连与宿主混音，验证宿主退出后的行为。对应 **REQ-023**。 |
| **12** | **一条链接免安装看材料** | 从桌面端选一份文件或受支持内容，生成有期限、可撤销的只读链接。访客知道宿主何时可达，打不开时能看到原因。需要评论时再给评论授权。对应 **REQ-002**。 |
| **13** | **快速建立和收尾临时任务群** | 面向值班、工作坊或一次排障，快速选择已有联系人、发出邀请，结束后归档。先验证用户希望留下哪些记录，再考虑定时关闭或成员权限到期。 |
| **14** | **向指定联系人发一次通知** | 发前预览收件人，一次发送给一组明确选中的联系人。确有业务需要时加「请确认」按钮，并区分送达、已读和主动确认。适合换班通知、实验室维护和临时集合。 |
| **15** | **给迟到或新加入成员发交接包** | 有权成员选中几份旧文件和一段说明，发给明确的人。标明哪些文件可用、从哪里取、什么时候到期。适合轮班和项目接手。 |
| **16** | **一键把选定内容发给自己的另一台设备** | 预览并发送一段文字、图片或文件到自己的已绑定设备，也可明确选择联系人。先复用「发给自己」和现有内容保护，验证能否省掉重复粘贴和找设备的步骤。 |
| **17** | **团队部署配置与邮局健康面板** | 让管理员分发可审查的安全默认值和邮局地址，并查看服务是否可达、容量和保留期限。用户仍显式确认信任关系。 |
| **18** | **手机从系统分享菜单发文件，并能接收保存** | 先验证一个具体任务，例如手机拍照后发给局域网里的电脑，或从聊天保存收到的文件。实测文件权限、后台切换、接续和保存位置，再选原生还是宿主式 Web。 |
| **19** | **按需排障与脱敏诊断导出** | 用户主动检查发现和直连路径，看到最近失败原因，并可导出一份能交给支持人员的脱敏记录。复用现有观测，验证能否减少来回追问。 |
| **20** | **受控的群通知机器人** | 用已有 bot/MCP 授权实现一个真实用途，例如把实验设备状态发到一个指定群。限定目标、发送频率和权限，到期或撤销后停止。 |

## 三、有明确场景后再做 · 14 项

| # | 具体需求 | 值得启动的条件与最小范围 |
|---|---|---|
| **21** | **自己的手机浏览器成为已配对客户端** | 用户确实需要持续移动收发时，从现有 PWA 原型继续。先用真实手机验证双向消息、网关认证、地址变化和会话恢复，再确定后台行为。对应 **REQ-027**。 |
| **22** | **原生移动客户端** | 手机用户持续需要浏览器难以满足的系统分享、发现、通知或无线能力时，先做一个平台上的已绑定设备、文本和文件。 |
| **23** | **没有可用 IP 网络时，用 BLE 直连发短文本** | 有可复现的断网协作场景时，复用现有 macOS BLE rehearsal，在两台实体设备上验证已知联系人、短消息、拒绝错误身份和断线重连。 |
| **24** | **附近设备多跳通信或 Wi‑Fi Aware** | BLE 直连距离确实不够，且有支持设备时，先验证三台实体设备和中继掉线。单独量交付延迟、功耗、过期和重复转发。 |
| **25** | **通过 Reticulum/LXMF 和外接 RNode 发低带宽消息** | 有真实使用者、兼容硬件及可用无线链路时，先交换短文本和状态。明确身份如何映射、谁能转发或读内容、消息何时过期。完成链路测量后再评估 LoRa 语音。 |
| **26** | **跨站点通话和自管媒体中继** | 现有 LAN/VPN 能支撑聊天却反复无法通话时，比较经批准的直连和自管 STUN/TURN。明确谁运行服务、允许谁使用，以及服务不可用时如何恢复。 |
| **27** | **群视频、独立语音房、按键讲话和共享系统音频** | 四个可独立取舍的需求。**群视频**解决多人视觉沟通；**独立语音房**适合成员常进常出；**按键讲话**适合短而紧急的语音；**系统音频**适合共享演示声轨。按真实任务选一个验证。 |
| **28** | **组内文件目录与受权多源下载** | 同一批文件被反复索取，交接包已经不够时，支持授权发布、浏览和从合格来源获取。显示来源、过期、容量及完整性状态。 |
| **29** | **共享交接笔记或文档协作** | 审阅链接证明用户确实需要共同修改时，先做一个有版本、作者和离线冲突处理的共享笔记。看板、画布和实时共同编辑按各自需求评估。 |
| **30** | **按需翻译消息和转录语音** | 有持续的跨语言或无障碍需求时，从用户选中的单条消息或语音开始。保留原文和录音，明确在本机处理还是经明确同意后交给外部服务，量准确率和资源成本。 |
| **31** | **工作和私人身份分离、可迁移恢复** | 用户确实需要同机使用两个身份时，先做清晰的切换与通知、密钥、存储隔离。迁移优先验证现有加密备份和设备绑定。 |
| **32** | **按次发位置和离线地图** | 有现场协作需求时，先提供手动选择一个位置、指定收件人和有效期。离线地图按需要下载或导入，持续定位需要单独的使用场景和授权。 |
| **33** | **交接记录搜索和受控导出** | 现有搜索、收藏、转发和备份无法完成交接或复盘时，支持按时间、会话或文件筛选，并导出用户明确选择且有权导出的内容。 |
| **34** | **短期访客入口及受控附近发现** | 有频繁的访客协作时，先做一次性二维码或限时邀请。明确谁能加入、发什么、谁能撤销，以及如何阻止骚扰和重复加入。 |

## 四、现阶段暂缓 · 5 项

| # | 提案 | 何时值得重开 |
|---|---|---|
| **35** | 后台自动同步整个系统剪贴板或剪贴板历史 | 先验证第 16 项。如果显式发送仍解决不了高频任务，再证明授权范围、保留时间和密码、令牌等敏感内容的处理方式。 |
| **36** | 公共 DHT、全局目录、Tor 匿名身份 | 有具体的跨互联网发现或匿名通信需求，并明确可观察元数据、身份连续性和运营责任时。 |
| **37** | 默认全网广播、开放匿名房、必需的共享中心服务 | 确有园区级通知或开放社区需求，也有人负责受众范围、权限和滥用处理时。 |
| **38** | 广泛跨协议互通或更换桌面框架 | 有实际对接方，或现有框架存在经过同条件测量、无法在当前实现解决的瓶颈时。 |
| **39** | 积分分层、无明确范围的自动复制、常驻通用插件 | 资源稀缺问题或自动化消费者已经明确，而且可以通过限额、授权和撤销控制成本时。 |

**近期执行顺序建议：03 → 04/05 → 01/02。** 对 03 的首轮验收可以很具体：一个发送者、两个受邀接收者、一个可见但不在群内的账号。分别让接收者拒收、中途掉线和遭遇保存失败，再测试发送端在完整托管前后离线。每次都核对**接收端实际发生的结果**和**发送端据界面得出的判断**。如果问题主要在理解，就先修状态表达。如果字节确实无法恢复，再沿现有文件和邮局流程修对应缺口。

# REQ-029 requirements reassessment

Source audit against \`0ae1a692\`. This supersedes the priority recommendations in [the landscape report](req-029-landscape.md). The landscape and source notes remain research evidence. A peer feature establishes precedent. A verified product contract establishes the baseline. A product change needs an observed gap or an explicit decision to explore a new capability. No runtime tests or user observations were performed in this reassessment.

## Disposition of every original item

| ID | Decision | Correction |
|---|---|---|
| 01 | Acceptance scenario | Clean install, local identity, first verified reachable peer and first message already have a documented path. Run offline and fix the first observed barrier. |
| 02 | Merge with 19 | Manual endpoints and route diagnostics already exist. Select one unresolved diagnosis, such as a known reachable device with discovery blocked, and verify a correct next action without implying discovery proves reachability. |
| 03 | First validation candidate | Start with direct file delivery. Separate received card, separately authorized bytes, endpoint completion and local save. Expose only observations already supported or separately approved. Group copy status is aggregate confirmation of message records. Remove implied per-member save tracking. |
| 04 | Merge with 03/05 as regression coverage | Chunking, folders, batch staging and per-item retry already exist. Test partial success and restart. Open one specific defect if reproduced. A batch manager or cancel contract needs its own demand. |
| 05 | Merge with 03 | A relay's historic record is neither current complete byte availability nor recipient completion. Test complete versus incomplete custody with sender off and an eligible source disappearing. Add guidance only where existing evidence supports it. |
| 06 | Existing feature qualification | Keep under experimental one-to-one calling. Test actual audio and video and capture cleanup on target native endpoints. Default exposure is a separate release decision. |
| 07 | Existing release/operations validation | Prove a disconnected install or upgrade with named artifacts and documented trust checks. Split binary restoration from data migration recovery. Native publisher signing and updater signatures have different scope. Coordinate package-size work where affected. |
| 08 | Cross-cutting acceptance | Use existing privacy and verification owners. Reproduce a specific incorrect understanding of discovery, admission, membership or content access before proposing a new surface. |
| 09 | Focused feature candidate | For asynchronous shift handoffs, explicitly record, review, send and play a bounded voice clip through the existing attachment path. Capture cleanup, consent and retention are acceptance conditions. |
| 10 | Focused feature candidate | On a qualified existing direct call, present a selected window to one peer, with visible sharing and immediate stop. Validate on supported native hosts; system audio, remote control and group sharing have separate scope. |
| 11 | Existing REQ-023 | Keep voluntary small group voice in its owning requirement. Resolve participant admission, topology, host exit and resource gates there. |
| 12 | Existing REQ-002 | Keep scoped browser review in its owning requirement. One explicitly shared object, authenticated host/origin and expiring, revocable authority; comments require a separate grant. |
| 13 | Park pending observed friction | Test existing group creation and departure. An observed need to hide a finished conversation could justify local presentation changes. Shared closure, membership expiry and deletion are separate consequences. |
| 14 | Park pending observed friction | Existing group announcements and bounded forwarding cover part of the proposal. Consider fresh text to multiple selected contacts only for recurring work these flows miss. Human acknowledgment collects a new signal and needs its own product decision. |
| 15 | Existing workaround first | Test manually forwarding selected eligible attachments and text to an admitted recipient. A dedicated bundle needs repeated unmet handoff workflow; best-effort provenance, current permission, expiry and unavailable contents matter. |
| 16 | Existing workaround first | Use Message Yourself and ordinary chat paste with selected recipients. Consider a share action only after measuring repeated unnecessary steps. Exact physical-device targeting is a separate sync/authority change. |
| 17 | Split, conditional operations work | Treat deployable defaults and relay health as distinct ideas. Validate an operator task first. Reuse existing services and diagnostics, publish no recipient metadata, and preserve explicit trust approval. |
| 18 | Acceptance of 21 or 22 | Use one phone file share-in and save-out scenario as input to the client decision. Remove the independent feature row from the active backlog. |
| 19 | Merge with 02 | Existing Connection diagnostics and log export are the baseline. Fix only a verified missing diagnostic or redaction problem. No new periodic probe or duplicate export feature. |
| 20 | Integration usage trial | Pick a real authorized consumer for existing bot and MCP surfaces. Create core work only for a capability or safety issue the trial exposes. |
| 21 | Existing REQ-027 | Qualify the existing separate PWA prototype on a real phone with trusted bootstrap, active-session round trip and recovery after endpoint change. Keep host authority and browser identity explicit. |
| 22 | Conditional client strategy | Consider a native client only when a measured mobile requirement, such as native sharing or lifecycle, cannot be met with the intended web experience. Choose a platform and authority model before planning feature parity. |
| 23 | Conditional transport feasibility | Existing macOS rehearsal proves bounded authenticated echo in its tested scope. Require a recurring no-usable-IP job and a supported device pair before proving product-level direct text delivery. |
| 24 | Split, research only | Forwarding via a third device and native Wi-Fi Aware are separate design axes. Defer routing until direct link limits matter. Investigate Wi-Fi Aware only for target hardware that needs the connectivity path. |
| 25 | Split, research only | LXMF interop has identity and protocol boundaries. External RNode/LoRa has hardware, throughput, operating and maintenance constraints. A narrow job and an available test setup are needed for either. |
| 26 | Conditional call networking | Let 06 identify the failing boundary. TURN may address certain ICE media failures. It cannot supply current direct application signaling or bypass organizational network policy. Define operator and service cost before adding a dependency. |
| 27 | Split and park | Group video, independent voice rooms, push-to-talk and system audio solve four different jobs. Each needs its own scenario and admission, device and media evidence. |
| 28 | Drop from core backlog | Publishing a file catalog and operating distributed seeding form a separate file-distribution product. Existing authorized handoffs and retention are the appropriate default. |
| 29 | Close broad proposal | Keep read-only review and any scoped comments with REQ-002. Shared editing, notes, boards and canvases are separate products with conflict and retention owners. |
| 30 | Park independently | Translation and transcription have different audiences, permissions and budgets. Require an actual language or accessibility need and explicit processing scope before allowing either. |
| 31 | Split, close feature claim | Validate existing encrypted recovery and linking. Only recurring identity separation can justify multiple profile support. |
| 32 | Drop from core backlog | Maps and location tracking serve a field coordination product. A separately confirmed need could justify sharing one manually selected point as an ordinary message first. |
| 33 | Split and use baseline | Search, history, Favorites, forwarding and backup are established. Qualify them against one handoff. A new plaintext export needs an explicit recipient, protected-content behavior and retention decision. |
| 34 | Split and park | Browser review belongs to REQ-002. Guest group admission, nearby stranger contact and public discovery independently expand authority and need REQ-018/025 evidence. |
| 35 | Close | Background clipboard monitoring and history risk exposure of unrelated secrets and introduce idle work. Explicit content sending is the bounded route. |
| 36 | Close | Public DHT/global directory and Tor profiles solve a different trust and networking problem. Only revisit against a concrete requirement with its own threat model. |
| 37 | Close | All-network sending, public anonymous rooms and required central service would change the current audience or deployment model. A proven operator-owned facility broadcast would be a separate requirement. |
| 38 | Close | Framework replacement and broad interchange are implementation proposals. Require a measured limit or real consumer with a defined contract. |
| 39 | Close bundled proposal | Scoped automation uses 20, authorized custody already has owners, and incentives belong to REQ-028 only for actual scarcity. No standalone bundle. |

## Immediate decision gates

1. Establish the observed file problem using a direct conversation. Compare sender interpretation to the recipient's card, consent, complete validated bytes and actual save. Use a failed write and a retry. Then test existing invited group and eligible relay, using separate expected results for each. Show an unknown state where there is no authorized evidence. If all flows are already clear, close the presentation hypothesis.
2. Validate first contact and troubleshooting without internet. Include permission-denied and discovery-blocked cases with a legitimately reachable address and a case with no route. Capture the first failing step before changing the flow.
3. Qualify ongoing native calling and release work through existing owners. Treat screenshots, audio/video playback and secure-distribution checks as separate evidence from successful text exchange.
4. If explicitly selecting one new feature, prefer a bounded asynchronous voice note or authenticated window sharing based on which underlying workflow occurs in practice. Advance browser review, group voice and mobile through REQ-002, REQ-023 and REQ-027.

content.text:
复核了全部 39 项。上一版最大的错误，是**把竞品有的功能、Mesh Talk 已经实现的能力，以及还没证实的用户痛点，都写成了待开发需求**。尤其是「做文件交付状态」这个建议说得过满。现有界面已经有文件进度、失败重试和副本说明，目前缺的是证据证明用户在哪一步被误导，或者哪种恢复路径确实失败。

**修订后，REQ-029 近期只保留两条验证主线**：文件交付与恢复、离线首次联系与排障。语音消息和一对一窗口共享保留为两个独立的新功能候选。浏览器审阅、群语音、移动 PWA 回归原有需求。其余逐项合并、缩小或暂缓。下面按原编号列出处理结果。

## 01–08：多数是现有能力的验收

| # | 复核与修正 |
|---|---|
| **01 离线首次上手** | **改为验收场景。** 已有本地身份、自动发现、私信和失败指引。用断网的干净安装找出第一个实际阻塞点，再决定是修安装、权限提示还是发现流程。 |
| **02 连接诊断** | **和 19 合并。** 已有连接诊断和手动地址。先验证两个容易混淆的场景：组播被挡但已知地址可达，以及设备已被发现但实际没有可用路由。只有现有界面给不出正确下一步时，才有具体改动。 |
| **03 文件交付状态** | **保留为第一验证项，撤掉默认做逐成员状态的建议。** 先测一对一文件，分别核对文件卡片、接收同意、字节校验、完成凭证和接收端保存。群聊的副本状态确认的是消息记录，不能用来推断某个成员已保存文件。 |
| **04 批量文件和文件夹** | **并入 03/05 的回归场景。** 分块、文件夹、批量暂存和失败重试已有基础。「统一批量管理器」和「批量取消」缺少需求证据，先查部分成功、重启及低磁盘时究竟哪里出错。 |
| **05 离线交付** | **并入 03。** 上一版把「看出文件已完整托管」写成了普遍可给出的承诺。需要分别验证完整托管、部分托管、来源过期和发送端离线。界面只能按实际证据说明此刻还需要谁在线。 |
| **06 一对一音视频** | **归现有实验性通话验收。** 验证真实双机能听见、看见，以及拒绝权限、路由丢失、挂断后释放设备。扩大默认开放范围是单独的发布决定。 |
| **07 断网安装与更新** | **归发布与运维验收。** 原文的「签名安装包与回滚」过于笼统。应分别验证发行物、更新载荷和系统安装的信任机制。恢复旧版程序也不能自动保证旧版能读迁移后的数据。 |
| **08 身份和隐私说明** | **作为相关流程的验收条件。** 发现、可联系、入群和读内容需要各自的权限。找到一个具体误解再改对应位置，无须另开一个泛化的「隐私解释」功能。 |

文件部分最关键的依据是现有文档已经区分了卡片、文件字节和群副本。优先验证用户能否理解已有信号，以及系统在失败时有没有足够证据解释结果。[文件指南](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029/docs/help/topics/send-files.md) · [群副本与文件交付](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029/docs/help/topics/channels.md:113)

## 09–20：两个新功能候选，其余回到已有流程或原需求

| # | 复核与修正 |
|---|---|
| **09 异步语音消息** | **保留。** 这是独立、讲得清楚的任务：交接时说一段，对方稍后听。最小范围是短录音、试听、重录、明确发送和播放，复用现有附件的加密、接收与保留规则。 |
| **10 一对一窗口共享** | **保留，依赖 06。** 截图已有。这里的需求是排障或演示时，通话里的另一人能持续看到一个用户选定的窗口。首版验证可见的共享状态和一键停止，系统音频、远程控制和多人共享各自独立。 |
| **11 小群语音** | **归回 REQ-023。** 沿用已入群成员自愿加入的范围，再决定人数、传输拓扑和发起者退出行为。 |
| **12 浏览器免安装审阅** | **归回 REQ-002。** 第一版只授权访客看一份指定内容，并明确有效期、撤销和宿主可用性。附带评论需要单独授权。 |
| **13 临时任务群** | **暂缓。** 「快速建群」「完成后从我的列表收起」「全员关闭」「成员到期」「清除记录」是五种不同结果。先用当前群流程验证。如果用户只是想清理列表，改本地展示即可。 |
| **14 定向通知** | **暂缓。** 现有群公告和多目标转发已覆盖部分场景。仅当用户反复需要向不同联系人发送同一条新通知，且现有方式明显费力，才考虑独立入口。「请确认」会产生新的个人反馈信号，需要另定范围。 |
| **15 迟到成员交接包** | **先验证现有转发。** 有权成员可以显式转发符合条件的附件和说明。只有反复发生内容遗漏、接收范围不清或来源失效，才值得做专门交接流程。 |
| **16 一键发往另一设备** | **先用「发给自己」验证。** 手工粘贴和发送已经能覆盖多数需求。若用户需要的其实是准确投递到某一台物理设备，那是新的设备寻址和同步语义，需要单独立项。 |
| **17 团队配置与邮局健康** | **拆开，按实际运维任务立项。** 分发安全默认值和判断邮局是否健康是两件事。先找一个具体故障或重复配置步骤，复用现有服务和诊断。 |
| **18 手机分享和保存** | **作为 21/22 的客户端验收。** 用「手机系统分享菜单发一个文件，电脑接收」和反向保存测试比较方案，无须独立立产品需求。 |
| **19 排障与日志导出** | **并入 02。** 当前已有连接诊断和日志导出。若能复现一处诊断误导、脱敏遗漏或缺失线索，修那一处。 |
| **20 群通知机器人** | **用现有 bot/MCP 试一个真实用途。** 这是现有能力的使用验证。只有发现权限或功能确实不足，才产生核心改动。 |

这里还纠正了「重发、通知、交接包都需要新功能」的假设。当前转发已有受限的多目标选择、部分失败和重试。先用它跑过真实流程，再判断缺的是哪一步。[转发契约](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029/docs/message-forwarding.md)

## 21–34：拆开混在一起的提案，移出偏离主线的功能

| # | 复核与修正 |
|---|---|
| **21 已配对浏览器/PWA** | **归回 REQ-027。** 已有独立原型。先用实体手机验证网关身份、双向消息、地址变化和会话恢复。 |
| **22 原生移动客户端** | **保留为条件性决策。** 先用 18 的实际任务证明浏览器方案在哪里达不到要求，然后才选平台和最小功能范围。 |
| **23 BLE 直连短文本** | **保留为可行性研究。** 当前是双 Mac 的认证回显演练。只有出现重复的「无可用 IP 但附近设备仍需通信」场景，才验证真正的发送、收件和重连。 |
| **24 BLE 多跳或 Wi‑Fi Aware** | **拆开并暂缓。** 多跳是转发职责，Wi‑Fi Aware 是特定设备的连接方式。前者依赖直连距离确实不足，后者依赖目标硬件和原生平台能力。 |
| **25 Reticulum/LXMF 和 RNode/LoRa** | **上一版错误地绑在一起。** LXMF 互通要先解决协议、身份和权限映射。LoRa 要先有硬件、实际链路和容量需求。两个各自成立后才值得安排试验。 |
| **26 跨站点通话和 TURN** | **先定位失败，再谈方案。** TURN 可以解决部分 WebRTC 媒体可达问题。Mesh Talk 当前的应用信令还需要自己的直连路径。先通过 06 判断实际失败发生在哪里。 |
| **27 群视频、独立语音房、按键讲话、系统音频** | **拆成四项，各自暂缓。** 四项的用户任务、参与规则和资源成本不同。先有重复场景，再选其中一个评估。 |
| **28 文件目录和分布式做种** | **移出核心待办。** 这会把一次聊天里的附件交付扩展成长期文件发布和分发服务，新增目录授权、配额及供应责任。当前优先把受权附件交付做清楚。 |
| **29 共享笔记、看板、画布和实时编辑** | **移出核心待办。** 审阅和可能的评论归 REQ-002。共同编辑需要版本、冲突和权限模型，竞品有这些功能不足以支持 Mesh Talk 做一套。 |
| **30 翻译与转录** | **拆开并暂缓。** 翻译需要有反复出现的跨语言任务。转录需要语音使用或无障碍需求。两者分别确认处理位置、用户同意和资源成本。 |
| **31 多身份与可迁移恢复** | **拆开。** 恢复和设备绑定已有，遇到问题走现有流程。只有确实需要在同机隔离工作和私人身份时，才讨论多身份。 |
| **32 位置和离线地图** | **移出核心待办。** 地图和持续位置属于现场调度方向。如果实际需求只是告诉同伴会合地点，一次性位置消息就足以先验证。 |
| **33 搜索与导出** | **先验收已有能力。** 搜索、历史、收藏、转发和备份都有现有入口。只有明确交付对象和使用目的后，才评估新的明文导出及保护内容处理。 |
| **34 访客和附近发现** | **拆开并暂缓。** 网页访客审阅归 REQ-002。访客入群会改变成员权限，允许附近陌生人联系会改变接触规则。两者都需要独立场景和授权。 |

## 35–39：从当前待办移除

| # | 复核与修正 |
|---|---|
| **35 后台剪贴板同步和历史** | 容易连带发送无关的密码、令牌和临时内容，还引入常驻监听。显式发送选定内容足以验证目前提出的用途。 |
| **36 公共 DHT、全局目录、Tor 匿名身份** | 服务的是公网发现或匿名通信。当前需求集中在已知团队、可达网络和明确授权，缺少改变信任模型的理由。 |
| **37 默认全网广播、开放匿名房、必需中心服务** | 会改变默认受众、准入或部署方式。若将来确有园区公告，可以按有管理者、明确范围的产品需求单独评估。 |
| **38 大范围协议互通或换框架** | 这是技术方案。没有具体对接方或经过测量的瓶颈，无法定义用户收益和验收。 |
| **39 积分、自动复制、常驻插件** | 原本把三件无关的事绑成一项。自动化走现有授权，副本走现有托管规则，积分只在 REQ-028 有实际资源分配问题时考虑。 |

## 修订后的第一步

**先做一对一文件交付走查。** 发件人发送一个普通文件，接收端依次跑正常接收、拒收、中断恢复、保存失败重试。每次独立记录接收端真实结果、发送端已有的状态凭证，以及用户能从界面做出的判断。确认一对一语义后，再扩到受邀群和邮局，分别定义预期，不沿用同一套完成含义。

- 如果**已有证据但用户理解错**，改现有文案或状态展示。
- 如果**字节本应可恢复却取不到**，复现并修对应传输或托管缺口。
- 如果**产品当前没有权限或没有证据**，显示未知，另行决定是否值得增加凭证。
- 如果**现有流程能完成任务，双方也能正确判断结果**，关闭这条假设，转做离线首次联系与排障验证。

39 项的逐条修订已写入 [REQ-029 复核报告](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029/tmp/req-029-reassessment.md)，原竞品报告已标注以本次排序为准。本轮是基于 `0ae1a692` 的源码和文档复核，没有运行真实双机测试，也没有改产品代码。

**English note**

Original — “复核一下所有的需求，哪些是乱说的、不适合这个项目的、哪些没说清楚。”  
Better — “Reassess every proposed requirement and flag anything unsupported, out of scope, or underspecified.”  
Why — “Unsupported” 指缺乏证据，“out of scope” 指超出项目边界，“underspecified” 指范围或验收条件还没说清。  
Useful pattern — “For each item, decide whether to keep it, narrow it, merge it, or drop it.”  
Collocations — reassess a proposal, verify the baseline, narrow the scope, define acceptance criteria.
再重新全部仔细复核一次清楚，不合适当前项目的删除，错误的修正，analyze；analyze；analyze；analyze；analyze；analyze；
我会再核对全部 39 项，并整理出一份实际保留的清单。此前的复核报告会作为决策记录，方便追溯哪些条目被删除、合并或归回原需求。

重新逐项核对了原来的 **39 项**。清理后，**REQ-029 当前只保留两项验证任务，没有已证实、可直接开工的新功能**。另有两个新功能候选，等实际场景成立再立项。两个旧报告已标注以这份清单为准。[REQ-029 当前清单](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029/tmp/req-029-current-scope.md)

## 当前只保留两项

| 保留项 | 修正后的范围与验收 |
|---|---|
| **文件交付与失败恢复**（合并 03、04、05） | 先在一对一 LAN 会话验证正常接收、拒收、中断和保存失败后重试。逐次核对接收端实际结果与发送端可见证据。文件卡片、完整字节、完成凭证和用户保存是不同事实。群副本和邮局托管另按各自语义验收。**删除逐成员保存追踪、默认能判断实时托管完整性、另做批量管理器的建议。** [网络交付契约](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029/docs/network-design-reference.md:1567) |
| **断网首次联系与排障**（合并 01、02、19） | 用现有安装、发现、手动地址和诊断入口，验证三种情况：同一 LAN 可达、组播被挡但已知地址可达、设备能发现但没有可用路由。记录用户卡在哪一步、界面有没有给出正确行动。**删除新建诊断面板、日志导出和常驻探测的建议。** [现有诊断指南](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029/docs/help/topics/diagnostics.md) |

**先验证文件交付。** 仓库已经记录了跨站点中继故障后恢复文件、接收端保存并向发送端返回完成凭证的实机证据。当前要补的是：普通用户遇到失败时，能否根据界面正确理解结果并继续操作。如果走查表明现有行为已经清楚、正确，就关闭该假设。如果复现问题，只修对应的提示或恢复路径。[现有实机证据](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029/docs/network-design-reference.md:3730)

## 两个候选，暂不进入开发队列

- **09 异步语音消息。** 如果值班或异步交接中反复遇到文字难以表达的问题，做短录音、试听、明确发送和播放，复用现有加密附件流程。
- **10 一对一窗口共享。** 如果在线排障确实需要持续看同一个窗口，先验收现有实验性通话的原生双机表现，再做选定窗口、可见的共享状态和立即停止。[现有通话说明](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029/docs/help/topics/calls.md)

## 其余条目的处理

| 原编号 | 处理结果 |
|---|---|

content.text:
复核后，**REQ-029 全部值得保留的事项有 4 项。前两项现在就能做验证，后两项是有明确交付范围的新功能候选。** 我建议先做第 1 项。

## 现在就能做

1. **让用户看懂文件有没有交付，以及失败后怎么继续。**  
   先在一对一局域网会话走查正常保存、拒收、中断恢复和保存失败重试。每次核对接收端实际发生的结果，以及发送端能根据现有凭证知道什么。**第一版只修复测出的缺口**，例如把仅确认文件卡片到达的状态说清楚，或让接收人从保存失败处直接重试。群聊和邮局场景随后分别验证。  
   **验收**：用户能正确判断当前状态并找到下一步。缺少证据时明确显示未知。

2. **让新用户在没有互联网时找到同伴，连接失败时知道怎么排障。**  
   用干净安装和现有入口走三条路径：同一局域网正常发现、组播被挡但知道可达地址、能看见同伴却连不上。记录第一个阻塞点，再修对应的权限提示、手动地址入口或连接诊断。  
   **验收**：有可用路径时，两人能发出并收到第一条消息。没有可用路径时，用户能看到具体原因，或者知道下一步该检查什么。

## 场景成立后可以开发

3. **异步语音消息。**  
   面向换班、现场汇报等「说起来快、对方稍后听」的场景。第一版支持**录一段短语音 → 试听或重录 → 明确发送 → 对方播放**。复用现有加密附件的接收与保留规则。  
   **验收**：取消录音、离开页面或锁定后释放麦克风。录完可以先预览，收到并保存的语音可离线播放。

4. **一对一通话中实时共享一个窗口。**  
   面向远程排障或演示。先在目标桌面平台的实体双机上验证现有实验性通话。第一版只做**选择一个窗口 → 对方实时看到 → 任一端结束通话后停止共享**，共享者始终能看见共享状态并主动停止。  
   **验收**：权限拒绝、窗口关闭、锁屏和挂断时都有明确反馈，采集及时停止。

这 4 项是清理后的完整 **REQ-029** 清单。浏览器免安装审阅、群语音、移动 PWA 继续分别归 **REQ-002、REQ-023、REQ-027**。[REQ-029 当前范围与验收标准](/Users/kingsonwu/programming/OctopusGarage/mesh-talk/.worktrees/req-029/tmp/req-029-current-scope.md)

Useful pattern — “For each requirement, define the smallest useful first version.”

## One-to-one window sharing

The connected call owns a single display capture. The UI requires a negotiated outbound video transceiver and an available picker. Picker output must be one window video track, with system audio excluded. The selected track temporarily replaces the sender's original camera track. The microphone and signaling paths remain independent. Track end, explicit stop, call retirement and lock release the captured tracks. A permission failure or rejected camera replacement leaves the existing call running and shows feedback. Pending picker completion has no authority after hangup. There is no new polling, signaling, durable storage or startup work. Capture requests limit frame rate to 15 fps. CPU, memory and actual encoding cost on native display capture remain unmeasured.

The source-identical Chromium run passed 11 scenarios. The two-peer case used real WebRTC and a synthetic selected window with a known pixel signature. It verified the signature in decoded remote video, camera restoration, and release when the remote side hangs up. Store tests covered picker denial, late grant, unexpected screen selection, inactive video transceiver and ended-track restoration. The development verifier passed 2,554 selected frontend tests. Native picker and physical audio/camera evidence are separate.
EOF`}))
